verdict.rationale: Superpowers' core subagent-driven-development workflow dispatches engineering tasks to subagents that implement, review, and continue autonomously (sometimes for hours), which is a clear form of task delegation to an embedded AI worker — but it operates as a skill layer on top of a host agent (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) rather than a wholly self-contained built-in assistant, and community reports note a recent update removed subagents from the self-review step, folding that back into the main agent. Missing for 10: a truly standalone built-in assistant independent of a host LLM/agent, and confirmation the subagent delegation is stable/undiminished across recent releases.
